hotels.title: Hedonistic Helsinki Haven with Scandinavian-Style Bistro
hotels.description: Helsinki is synonymous with cool, style and design, and Hotel Indigo Helsinki is no exception. Among the unique murals designed by local artists find a treasure trove of bespoke, modern facilities including Restaurant Bröd ('bread') an urban bistro serving Finnish delicacies, locally baked bread and mouthwatering seafood. After days spent exploring, step into the Finnish sauna at the Body, Mind & Soul Studio to relax and steam the day away, Fin-style.
